To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the NLO QCD corrections for the production of the Higgs boson in the Drell-Yan process at the LHC are positive for a wide range of Higgs boson mass values.
the NLO QCD corrections in the SANC system to the Drell-Yan process are implemented and that they are in good agreement with other results.
the QCD correction factors are in the range 1.0 to 1.2 and that the uncertainty due to the choice of the scale in the calculation of the correction is 10 to 15 percent.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a new generation of high performance computing systems capable of solving large scale problems of the type described above, and the application of these systems to the simulation of particle physics experiments.

the study of the NLO QCD corrections in the SANC system to charged and neutral Drell-Yan lepton pair production in the framework of the massive quark approach and the comparison of the results with the ones obtained in the massless scheme.
a novel approach to the study of the structure of the nucleon, which is based on the analysis of the structure functions of the nucleon in the framework of the SANC program.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the SANC system provides a very powerful tool for the calculation of NLO QCD corrections for a wide range of processes.
the Drell–Yan processes are well understood at the level of NLO in QCD, and that the theoretical uncertainties in the predictions for these processes are well under control.
there is a strong case that the SANC approach is a viable alternative to other existing approaches.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SANC system is an effective tool for the NLO QCD calculations of a wide range of high-energy processes.

we have developed an efficient and reliable method for computing the NLO QCD corrections, which can be applied to a wide class of processes, including the Drell-Yan production of a heavy lepton pair, the Drell-Yann production of a heavy quark pair, and the Drell-Yanan production of a heavy Higgs boson pair.
we have completed the calculation of the NLO QCD corrections for the Drell-Yan production of the W boson in the SANC system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can use the SANC framework to calculate the next-to-leading order (NLO) QCD corrections to any process.
the NLO QCD corrections for the process e+e- -> Z -> e+e- are not large enough to significantly reduce the uncertainty of the cross section due to scale variation.
we have shown that the SANC system can produce NLO results for Drell-Yan and W/Z-boson production in hadronic collisions with a precision comparable to other public codes, such as MCFM and VBFNLO.
